description: Test suite for approval callback data handling functions in a Telegram bot extension, including boundary checks, data rewriting, and sanitization.

methods.name: fitsTelegramCallbackData
methods.description: Checks if the callback data fits within Telegram's byte boundary (up to 64 bytes).

methods.name: rewriteTelegramApprovalDecisionAlias
methods.description: Replaces '/approve ... allow-always' with '/approve ... always' in callback data.

methods.name: sanitizeTelegramCallbackData
methods.description: Ensures callback data is within 64-byte limit, returning undefined if it exceeds.
